rows.counterargument: Aircraft location accurate. Event is 130 miles / 2 hours' drive from St. Louis — the compiler footnoted the drive. Charlie Kirk is not named as the speaker. SU-BND had already been parked in St. Louis since 21 Feb. Duncan Aviation has held the Egyptian Air Force Falcon/VIP maintenance account since 1999; Lincoln is the main plant, Provo a second facility. A landing at Lincoln, Omaha (15-min hop to Lincoln), Wichita (Yingling Falcon service centre), or Wilmington (outbound customs only) is also what that contract produces.
rows.notes: One of six dates that survive the directory's same-day-or-adjacent test, at a distance.

NEITHER KIRK IS PLACED IN MISSOURI on any date in this window by any source; the Kirk side is an organisation's event, not a person's location. SU-BTT flew its standard Cairo->Paris->US field->sit->Wilmington->Cairo rotation unchanged. THE COMPILER FOOTNOTED HIS OWN WEAKNESS: his note reads 'Event is in Jefferson City, MO (2 hrs from St. Louis)'.
rows.notes: ADDED FROM THE OVERLAP PAGE, which had no row in this file. The clustering claim's MISSOURI leg rests substantially on this one date; if the two-hour drive disqualifies it, Missouri thins out considerably. Three separate metro airports are in play (KSTL Missouri, KCPS ILLINOIS, KSUS Missouri) and a state-level tally cannot distinguish them.

Ep 256: lands Omaha then 'straight flies straight over to Lincoln and it stays in Lincoln for a mysterious 5 days.' The 15-minute hop is a shop reposition, not a surveillance orbit. Duncan Aviation has held the Egyptian Air Force Falcon/VIP maintenance account since 1999; Lincoln is the main plant, Provo a second facility. A landing at Lincoln, Omaha (15-min hop to Lincoln), Wichita (Yingling Falcon service centre), or Wilmington (outbound customs only) is also what that contract produces.
rows.notes: Ep 256: campus tour publicly announced Feb 8; plane comes in Feb 9.

rows.counterargument: A CHAPTER OPENING IS NOT A KIRK APPEARANCE - nothing places Charlie Kirk in Lincoln on this date. The aircraft arrived 9 Feb and left 14 Feb: it did not arrive for the event and did not leave with it. THE DOCUMENTARY COUNTERARGUMENT IS DECISIVE: a Duncan Aviation press release of 29 Oct 2015 records a five-year direct contract with the Egyptian Air Force and states Duncan has managed the EAF Falcon fleet's maintenance SINCE 1999 - fifteen years before Charlie Kirk's public career. AND THE 2023 COUNTER-CASE IS STRONGER: on 25 Aug 2023 Charlie Kirk actually spoke in Lincoln, and the audit places the aircraft IN EGYPT that day.
rows.notes: ADDED FROM THE OVERLAP PAGE, which had no row in this file. The clearest genuine same-airport co-location in the directory - and the one with the most ordinary explanation sitting directly on top of it. A weaker item sits three days earlier: Charlie Kirk's campus tour was publicly ANNOUNCED on 8 Feb 2024 and SU-BTT arrived at Omaha the next morning. AN ANNOUNCEMENT IS NOT A LOCATION.
